column1: # NOF -- `nof(n, ...c)` (G12 phase 5, ADR-048): the number of trial
# schemas c that admit the settled value must be one the count n admits,
# an integer or a count constraint as `len` takes. A branch admits the
# value when their meet adds nothing and generates the value itself; a
# scalar is tried at the meet and a container at generation. Branches
# are canon-sorted and never deduplicated, a branch that conflicts on
# its own admits nothing, and `nof` is opaque to emptiness and
# subsumption, as `must` is. Every expectation is both engines' agreed
# Canon: branches sorted by canon and never deduplicated; the atom once.
